name: trade-context-electrician
note: trade_context shipped on 2026-08-09 and had never been exercised: the prompt has always had a slot for it and nothing ever filled it. This is the case it exists for — 'eight of the 20 mil' is cable to an electrician and pipe to a plumber, and 'the board' is a consumer unit rather than a plank. buildUserPrompt reads trade_context straight off the fixture, so this scores the same string the app now sends.
transcript: Quote for Mrs Chen at number 42. Eight double sockets, sixty each fitted. About eight metres of the 20 mil, I'll price that when I've been to the wholesaler. New board as well — that's four hundred and twenty including the certificate. Day's labour on top, two hundred.
